fact: On 19 October 2026 the Ministry of Information warned media outlets, websites and social media administrators against spreading what it called terrorist propaganda on the South West conflict, and the Somali Journalists Syndicate reports four journalists arrested in South West State in 2026 for reporting.
title: Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Soomaaliya waa in ay joojisaa hanjabaadaha ay u jeedinayso saxafiyiinta ka warramaya colaadda ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed
